ai.seo_question: Which prayer is identified as the middle prayer (Salat al-Wusta) in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq asserts that these narrations constitute definitive proof (hujjah) against opposing sects, specifically resolving the Quranic ambiguity regarding the 'middle prayer' (Salat al-Wusta). By identifying it as Dhuhr, he aligns with the predominant Shia interpretation, emphasizing the structural integrity of the five daily prayers and countering claims that might diminish the status of any specific prayer.
